verifiedInvariants.expiryDiscovery: all elapsed pending approvals are discoverable under the current EventStore epoch and tenant scope
verifiedInvariants.exactlyOnceExpiry: expiry and its encrypted ApprovalExpired fact commit once and deterministic redelivery replays that same fact
verifiedInvariants.lateDecisionFence: an approval decision carrying the former pending version cannot grant an expired approval
verifiedInvariants.noBypass: expired approvals retain no approval decision row and cannot authorize the protected tool transition
